# renderModelPrompt() function

Render bounded literal instructions with exact, one-pass `{{variable}}` substitution.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare function renderModelPrompt(definition: ModelPromptDefinition, values: Readonly<Record<string, string>>, template?: string): string;
```

**Returns:**

string

Instructions of at most 1 MiB UTF-8; inserted values are never reparsed.

## Exceptions

[KernelConfigurationError](./intention-kernel.kernelconfigurationerror.md) with `INVALID_MODEL_PROMPT` for invalid definitions, malformed placeholders, missing/extra values, or any template/value/output above 1 MiB.

## Example


```ts
renderModelPrompt({ id: "greeting", contractVersion: 1, template: "Hello {{name}}", variables: ["name"] }, { name: "Ada" });
```
